Olivia (Finance): Quick heads-up: billing tweaks going live 2026-05-01. Highlights: 72h overage grace, small free-tier rate-limit increases, and promo credits issued after the cutover will expire in 180 days.

Ravi (Eng): Quick Q 3 is grace applied per-account or per-key?

Olivia (Finance): Per-account for billing; Console still shows per-key usage for debugging.

Maya (Support): How will this appear on invoices?

legal-bot: Example: Usage: 300,000 tokens
Grace protection: -5,000 tokens
Overage charged: 0 tokens (within 72h)

Olivia (Finance): We'll add a "Grace protection" line item for visibility and a webhook/header field grace_expires_at.

Ravi (Eng): Any API header names so partners can integrate?

Olivia (Finance): We'll publish X-Redwood-Grace-Until (ISO timestamp) and update the usage webhook schema. Contract posted in #eng-platform.

Maya (Support): I'll update KB and canned replies. Please send the final FAQ before customer emails.

Olivia (Finance): Sending draft FAQ link now: https://redwood.internal/billing/may-2026-draft. Internal briefing Friday 10:00 PT.
